Decision: Choose hosting region and confirm attestation reports before any data moves
Context: Cloud service; residency rule applies; personal data possible
Options considered: Region A of the vendor list; region B; deploy only masked data; wait for a local region
Decision rationale: Residency and assurance are gating; masked data lowers risk in every option

Decision: Use an object-centric event model for P2P
Context: P2P links many POs, items, receipts and invoices
Options considered: Single case ID (purchase order item); object-centric model
Decision rationale: Avoids duplicated events and wrong counts; matches the many-to-many reality

Decision: Keep the extract thin and mask personal data before load
Options considered: Direct live connector; thin extract with masking; full replica
Decision rationale: Smallest data and risk; key stays in source domain

Decision: Implement control tests as configuration in the analysis engine
Context: Tests change often; audit needs history
Options considered: Custom code; spreadsheet; configured tests in the suite
Decision rationale: Versioned, owned, auditable; no custom code

Decision: Use AI as assistive only; keep beta and roadmap features out of the critical path
Options considered: Rely on all AI features; GA only; no AI
Decision rationale: Human decision stays; design survives feature changes

Decision: Start with the suite's prebuilt P2P content for the first view, then build the tailored model
Context: Need early value and a stable base
Options considered: Tailored model only; prebuilt only; both in sequence
Decision rationale: Fast first insight; tailored model for control tests

Decision: Route remediation through the workflow component; automation only after approval
Context: Corrective actions touch the source system
Options considered: Auto-remediate; manual only; approved workflow trigger
Decision rationale: Keeps segregation of duties and an audit trail
